```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Private ownership has been the best guarantee of conscientious stewardship of land and water.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The worst instances of environmental degradation have occurred under government control.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Economically advanced countries with respect and protection of private property rights also have the strongest environmental protections.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Economic progress in countries makes possible the conservation of natural resources.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Congress should reconsider whether parts of the federal government's landholdings and control of water in the West could be better used for ranching, mining, or forestry through private ownership.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Timber is a renewable natural resource that provides jobs to thousands of Americans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"All efforts should be made to make federal lands managed by the U.S. Forest Service available for harvesting.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"People best protect what they own.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A site- and situation-specific approach to an environmental problem is more likely to solve it than a national rule based on ideological concerns of politicized central planning.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Legislation should require congressional approval before any rule projected to cost in excess of $100 million to American consumers can go into effect.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Those closest to a situation are best able to determine its remedy.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A national rule is based on ideological concerns of politicized central planning.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
